title: ML 1: Regression, Gradient Descent and Classification
summary: Supervised vs. unsupervised learning, linear regression, cost functions, gradient descent, feature scaling, polynomial regression, classification, logistic regression, and regularisation.

title: ML 2: Neural Networks, Multiclass Classification and Model Diagnostics
summary: Activation functions, softmax and multi-label classification, ADAM, layer types, computation graphs, bias/variance, regularisation, transfer learning, skewed data, decision trees and tree ensembles vs. neural networks.

title: ML 3: Clustering, Anomaly Detection and Recommender Systems
summary: K-means clustering, anomaly detection with Gaussian distributions, recommender systems, collaborative filtering, principal component analysis, and an introduction to reinforcement learning.

title: ML 4: Sequence Models and Recurrent Neural Networks
summary: RNNs, forward/back-propagation through time, RNN architectures, language modelling, vanishing gradients, GRUs, LSTMs, bidirectional and deep RNNs.

title: ML 5: Word Representation, Embeddings and Sentiment Classification
summary: Word representation, transfer learning with word embeddings, the embedding matrix, neural language models, GloVe, and RNNs for sentiment classification.

title: ML 6: Sequence-to-Sequence Models, Beam Search and Attention
summary: Encoder-decoder models, beam search and length normalisation, error analysis, BLEU score, the attention mechanism, speech recognition, and trigger word detection.

title: ML 7: Transformer Networks
summary: Motivation for moving beyond recurrence, self-attention, multi-head attention, and the Transformer architecture.
